name: Felbertauerntunnel toll (Felbertauernstraße)
law: Felbertauernstraße AG's Mauttarife from 2026-01-01, under its Mautordnung (the company, owned by the Republic of Austria, the Land Tyrol and municipalities, charges for the tunnel section of the P1 Felbertauernstraße): the normal price per passage, either way, VAT included: over 3.5 t with 2 axles EUR 36.00, 3 axles EUR 54.00, 4 or more axles EUR 72.00. The Mautordnung's categories count the axles of the vehicle or combination (its pictures of category C4 are a tractor with semi-trailer and a truck with trailer). Discount cards (Rabattkarten) aren't modelled. The plaza is placed at its toll booths in OpenStreetMap, before the tunnel's south portal (Matrei in Osttirol).
